population.span: In a randomized, double-blind, noninferiority trial involving patients with acute venous thromboembolism who were initially given parenteral anticoagulation therapy for a median of 9 days (interquartile range, 8 to 11)

endpoint.span: Major bleeding episodes occurred in 20 patients assigned to dabigatran (1.6%) and in 24 patients assigned to warfarin (1.9%)

estimate.span: Major bleeding episodes occurred in 20 patients assigned to dabigatran (1.6%) and in 24 patients assigned to warfarin (1.9%) (hazard ratio with dabigatran, 0.82; 95% CI, 0.45 to 1.48)

ci.span: hazard ratio with dabigatran, 0.82; 95% CI, 0.45 to 1.48

analysis_set.span: did not fulfil the criteria from above. | TIME FRAME: From first intake of study drug to last intake of study drug + 6 days washout (washout time can be reduced until 0 day if the patient takes an other anti-coagulant therapy on and after last intake of active study drug) | POPULATION: Treated set (TS): consisted of all randomised patients

treatment_strategy.span: we compared oral dabigatran, administered at a dose of 150 mg twice daily, with warfarin that was dose-adjusted to achieve an international normalized ratio of 2.0 to 3.0.

follow_up.span: did not fulfil the criteria from above. | TIME FRAME: From first intake of study drug to last intake of study drug + 6 days washout

candidate_rejections.span: episodes of any bleeding were observed in 205 patients assigned to dabigatran (16.1%) and 277 patients assigned to warfarin (21.9%; hazard ratio with dabigatran, 0.71; 95% CI, 0.59 to 0.85)
candidate_rejections.why: Any bleeding, a broader endpoint than major bleeding; it sits in the same sentence as the served major-bleeding estimate.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults (>=18 y) with acute proximal DVT and/or PE needing >=6 months anticoagulation, randomised dabigatran vs warfarin after parenteral lead-in.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) of the leg involving proximal veins, and/or pulmonary embolism (PE) iin patients for whom at least 6 months of anticoagulant therapy is considered appropriate 2. Male or female, being 18 years of age or older

notes: RE-COVER (NCT00291330). Served HR 0.82 (0.45-1.48) equals the abstract's major-bleeding HR; registry result outcome 6 corroborates it ('Hazard Ratio (HR) 0.82 (95% CI 0.45 to 1.48)'; major bleeding events 20 vs 24 in treated set 1273 vs 1266). Analysis set and follow-up are registry spans (outcome 6 bleeding events, treated set); the span is anchored on the preceding definition text because the same TIME FRAME/POPULATION text recurs under outcome 8. 'iin' is a typo in the registry, copied verbatim. Registry any-bleeding count (207 vs 280) differs from the abstract (205 vs 277); not relevant to major bleeding. The europepmc_core.json abstract is truncated and lacks the bleeding sentence. n_t/n_c left null because they are not in the estimate span.
